tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i khrid yig gsal byed nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi them skas bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī rak+ta ya mā ri mārga kra mo pa de sha nish+tsi tār+tha badz+ra yo ga s+ya sau pā naṃ na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi them skas zhes bya ba/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyis ye shes gcig bsdus sku/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid khro bo'i tshul/ /rnam par ston mdzad dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed/ /dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon po gang der 'dud/ /rnam mang rgyud sde'i snying po mchog /shin tu spros med rdo rje'i tshig /nges don rnal 'byor them skas 'di/ /gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas bshad/ /'dir dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i lam rim pa gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ mdun du bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu lnga bkod pa/ stegs mtho bar bzhag de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga bshams/ rang rten la kha phyogs pa'i mdun du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang der 'bul ba'i rdzas 'bru la sogs pa byi dor byas pa dang / dri bzang po'i chu 'dus byas nas/ rang nyid bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug nas/ skyabs 'gro'i yul/ bla ma dkon mchog chos bsrung rnams yid la dran bzhin pas rgyud snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ ched du bya ba khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las bskyabs par 'dod pas/ dus 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar la/ rang dang pha mas gtso byas rigs drug thams cad skyabs 'gro byed par mos nas/ skyabs 'gro nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam song rjes/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o+o/

/lan gsum mdun gyi tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du seng ge'i khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rdo rje dkyil mo dkrung gi bzhugs shing / sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pas/ bdag la dges shing bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du/ dpal bir+wa pa la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi tshom bu dpag bsam shing gi sdong bu'i steng du pad ma nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa'i gdan so so'i steng du/ gshin rje'i gshed/ kye rdo rje/ bde mchog sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i yi dam gyi lha tshogs/ g.yas kyi tshom bu rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / shākya'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i sprul pa'i sku ste/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams bzhugs pa/ rgyab kyi tshom bu rin po che'i khri gos dar sna tshogs kyis bkab pa'i steng du lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i rang bzhin chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu/ g.yon gyi tshom bu pad zla'i steng du/ 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'i cha byad can rnams dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mau mgal gyi bu la sogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa can bzhugs pa de dag thams cad kyi mtha' skor du chos skyong srung ma nor lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/ de nas dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed dang bir+wa pa la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi rjes su/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam kyi lha tshogs dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag gi rgyud la spros med kyi ye shes skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshar gsum/ de rjes maṇ+ḍal la tshar gsum/ bla ma la tshar gsum/ yi dam la tshar gsum/ dkon mchog chos srung rnams la dbul/ de nas gong bzhin gsol gdab lan gsum bya/ de 'dra re tshar rer rtsis pa'i maṇ+ḍal skabs dang bstun pa phul rjes/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ chos skyong nor lha rnams 'od du zhu nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam la thim/ de rnams brgyud pa'i bla ma la thim/ de yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de la yang / yid kyi gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam zhing rtog med du cung zad bzhag de nas rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i snying khar zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer dkar po 'phros rang gi lus kyi nang gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam par bshang gci gnyis dang / rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon te shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par bsam la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de rjes spyod lam la 'jug par 'dod na/ dge rtsa bsngo/ slar yang skabs gang bder skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gong bzhin byas nas gshin rje'i gshed dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs bsgom la/ bzlas pa'i gong du thog mar rang gi spyan dbu ma la sems gtad/ de rjes rtsa ba'i spyan gnyis/ shangs khro gnyer dang bcas pa/

zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba mchu'i sgros dang bcas pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor/ phyag g.yas g.yon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa/ sku stod/ sku smad zhabs gnyis/ yum ma he gshin rje'i gdan/ rgyan dang cha lugs me ri'i bar la sems gtad/ de nas bzlas pa ci grub byas pa'i mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sogs 'dod don gsol gdab kyi rjes su/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs kyi dge rtsa bsngo'o/ /de nas rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang tshul ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngar bzhin byas rjes/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi 'dug nas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ gur/ me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rang nyid gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad nyi ma he gshin rje'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed du gsal gdab la/ puṣ+pe la sogs thun mong gi mchod pa dang / rū pa badz+ri la sogs phyi'i mchod pa dang / skad cig gis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsam nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod de/ bla ma la phul ba nang gi mchod pa/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ bde ba chen po'i rgyud gang ba gsang mchod/ cung zad rnam par mi rtog pa la gzhag pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams phul nas/ gang gi drin gyis sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rang gi bdag tu bzung ba'i longs spyod dgra gnyen thams cad bla ma la phul bar bsam/ de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che bdag gis bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

lan gsum/ rang gi mdun du thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum bsam te/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lag pa g.yas su ral gri thogs nas/ smin mtshams nas ltag pa'i bar bcad nas bzhag de nas rkang pa g.yas g.yon ro smad/ nang khrol/ ro stod/ lag pa g.yon/ mgo bo'i lhag ma/ mthar lag pa g.yas ral gri dang bcas pa/ thod pa'i nang du bskyur nas dum bur byas pa la dmigs nas 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir bsgyur ba/ rang gi snying kha nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa mang po spros/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la lan gsum 'bul/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma nas brtsams te/ gnod byed kyi bar gshin rje'i gshed du gsal bas phul bas dges shing tshim/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma thod pa dang bcas pa rtsa ba'i bla ma la phul bas thugs rgyud bde bas gang de bdag la byin gyis rlob par mos/ de nas mgron gzhan rnams mi dmigs par bsam ste/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams la sems gtad nas sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ rje dkon mchog 'phel bas mdzad pa'i tshig rigs bzhin brjod nas spros med kyi ngang la ci nus mnyam par 'jog rjes su brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kho bos byas pa'i chen mo'am gong gi de gang 'thad byas la/ chos kun stong pa nyid rtogs pas/ sogs brjod cing / don thugs la dran pas/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gsal btab/ de ltar mnyam gzhag la/ mi gnas na de'i rgyun bskyang ba ni/ skyabs sems rjes su/ ha gsum dang / hūm̐ gsum gyi stod smad kyis rlung ro bsal bas rang gi smin mtshams sor bzhi'i bar gyi nam mkha' la sems bzung / de nas mtho gang / mda' gang / 'dom gang / mthar nam mkha'i mtha'i bar la sems gtad/ des mtshon nas phyogs gzhan rnams la yang 'dra/ rnam rtog 'od gsal ni logs su bsgoms na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla ma spyi bor bsgom ste gsol ba btab pas rang la thim par bsam zhing /

snga ma'i skyus la byed na sngon 'gro de dag mi dgos phyi rol gyi rtog pa phra rags thams cad bu ga dgu nas snying khar bsdus la 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar yar ril mar ril lan gsum gyi rjes su snying khar bu ga blo kar lta bu byung ste/ de nas rang gi sems dang rnam rtog 'dres pa 'od kyi rnam par byas nas mdun phyogs kyi nam mkha'i mthar song / lus bem po de las rlung gis bskyod nas nub phyogs bde ba can du song / 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir gyur pa/ 'od dpag med 'khor bcas la mchod par phul/ sems 'od kyi rnam pa de la sems gtad pas je cher song bas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur te/ sems dang nam mkha' 'od gsal stong pa bzhi dbyer med du bsgom/ rjes snga ma bzhin de nas byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ skyabs sems kyi rjes su rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i spyi bor rin chen po che'i khri dang / pad nyi la/ bla ma gshin rje'i gshed du bsgom nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa lan ci mang gsol ba btab pas bla ma rang la thim par bsam zhing / spros med du bzhag rjes 'dra/ mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes snga ma bzhin las/ rang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnam par bsgom pa'i mdun du/ gnod pa che shos kyi dgra bo gcig dmigs nas/ 'di snying re rje zhes pa mang du bsgrang / cis snying rje na/ ma yin pa'i phyir snying rje/ ma de yang lan grangs mang du byas pas snying rje/ ma byas res kyis phan btags/ gnod pa las bskyabs pas snying rje/ yin pa ma yin yang gnod pa skyel ba'i phyir na snying rje/ gnod pa byas pa'i phyir/ ngan song du skye bas snying rje snyam du yang yang bsgom mo/ /des mtshon nas gnod byed bar ma/

chung ngu btang snyoms pa'i sems can gnyen/ mthar sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom pas sems can gshin rje'i gshed du gyur par bsam la spros med kyi ngang la bzhag go /rjes dge ba bsngo/ rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor ni/ sngon 'gro skyabs sems bla ma gshin rje'i gshed spyi bor bsgom/ gsol ba btab pas rang la thim/ rang gi mdun du dgra'am gnyen gang rung dmigs la 'di'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ rtsa ba bdag 'dzin thams cad rang gi snying kha'i dkyil 'khor du thim pas/ bdag 'dzin rlag par byas par bsam/ bdag la yod pa'i bde dge thams cad snying kha nas nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba bzhin spros te/ mdun na yod pa de la thim pas sdug bsngal dang bral zhing tshogs rdzogs nas gshin rje'i gshed du gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can thams cad la sngar bzhin bsgom/ 'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang / skyon du snang ba ji snyed pa thams cad bdag la bsdu zhing bdag gi yon tan de rnams la phul bas gshin rje'i gshed du gyur/ snod kyi 'jig rten la skyon can du snang ba thams cad kyang rang la bsdu zhing / rang gi bde dge btang bas dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur snyam du bsam pa sbyang zhing / 'byongs nas/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gis dge bas de kun bde thob shog /ces ngag tu brgya rtsa tsam brjod cing / don thugs la dran par mdzod/ mthar snod bcud thams cad kyang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rten dang brten par mos la/ spros med du ci nus bzhag rjes sngar dang 'dra/ srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor ni sngon 'gro gong bzhin mdzad nas/ rkang pa dkyil dkrung / lag pa rdo rje khu tshur brang du bsnol te kha nas ha'i gdangs kyis rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ yang sna'i g.yas g.yon dbus gsum la dmigs nas hūm̐ gi gdangs kyis lan gsum bus rjes/

lag pa pus mo gnyis la bkab/ mgo bo mdun du gug byas te sna nas rlung dal bus drangs te lte ba'i 'og tu mnan la mi thub la khad pa dang / slar yang nang du skyar rngub byas nas/ gsus pa dang / dpung pa g.yas gyen du thegs tshad bteg la 'og tu lhod kyi skyur zhing / g.yas kyi rlung sems dbu mar sib song bar bsam/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang 'dra/ 'degs dus 'phongs dang pus mo gdan las ma bral ba byed/ de ltar lan gsum gsum byed pa ni/ bsrub cing bsrub pa'o/ /rgya mtsho bskyod pa ni rlung 'dzin tshul snga ma 'dra bar byas la/ lto ba mdun nas g.yas su bskor te rgyab tu sgal tshigs la bcar btang nas/ g.yon phyogs su drag tu sprug de 'dra lan gsum g.yon la'ang de ltar bya/ bsad pa ni/ rlung 'dzin tshul gong bzhin la/ rkang pa gnyis tsog pu/ lag pa gnyis mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/ bsgom thag gi tshul du byas la/ dpung pa dang gzhogs g.yas rgyab tu gcu zhing yang mdun du lhod glod/ de lta bu lan gnyis bya/ yang g.yon du gcu ba gnyis/ gsus pa g.yas su bskor ba gnyis/ g.yon du bskor ba gnyis/ 'di dag la lus mi dkrug pus mo phyir phul la/ sgal tshigs rgyab tu 'then pa gnyis/ sgal tshigs phyir phul la pus mo mdun du 'then pa gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis gyen du sgreng ba gnyis/ 'og tu gdab pa gnyis/ 'di gnyis lhan cig tu bya ste/ de ltar na bcu drug go /yan lag brkyang bskum ni rlung bzung tshul snga ma ltar byas la/ mgo bo g.yas su bskor ba gsum/ g.yon du bskor ba gsum/ lag pa g.yas mgo la bskor nas/ dpung pa'i thad kar brkyang zhing sprug pa lan gsum/ de bzhin du/ lag pa g.yon pa la gsum/ rkang pa g.yas mdun du sprug pa gsum/ g.yon rgyab tu sprug pa gsum/ yang g.yas rgyab tu sprug pa gsum/ g.yon mdun du sprug pa gsum ste rkang pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'di dag mang nas bya zhing / 'di thams cad la rlung mi thub par phyir gtong dus lag pa gnyis kyis pus mo 'jus nas lus drag tu sprug cing /

sna bug gnyis nas shugs bskyed de bus la re zhig rlung phyir bzung / nang du yong dus dal bus sgra mi tshor bar bya/ cung zad ngal gsos te/ rlung sbyor bskyar nas byed pa'am/ yang na spros med kyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag ste/ dge ba bsngo zhing spyod lam la 'jug go /rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bar chad bsal ba rnams la dmigs thun du bcad cing bsgom pa'i srol mi 'dug gal srid nyams su len na yang glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig dang / spros med mdzes rgyan sogs yid ches pa'i gzhung lugs las rtogs par bya'o/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsung gi gsang ba'i mdzod/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bir+wa'i rjes 'brangs te/ /'khrul med dam pa'i bka' las byung ba bzhin/ dpal ldan dus dgra'i khrid yig 'di brtsams pa'i/ /dge ba dri med rnam dkar gang de'i mthus/ /khams gsum sems can srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /legs par bsgral te tshogs gnyis lhun grub sku/ /brjod bral rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog thob shog /ces pa 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun rat+na war+dha'i zhal gyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ sna tshogs 'od kyi lo mchu can gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ thub pa'i dbang po nyid kyis cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i dus mchod kyi tshes bco lnga'i bar la kha ba can gyi ljongs na che bar grags pa'i skye dgu kun gyi ral pa'i gtsug tor la bka'i bdud rtsi nye bar 'god pa'i mi'i dbang po shrī sgrol ma rab brtan dpal bzang po blon 'bangs dang bcas pa la dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams khrid du legs par phul ba'i skabs/ mi'i dbang po de nyid kyis gzhan las lhag pa'i rnam dpyod ches phul du byung bas bdag gi khrid yig zin bris su mdzad gnang ba la gzhi byas te gong 'og gi 'khrugs sdeb cing nyung la gsal bar gyis zhes bka' bstsal ba la brten nas/

khrid yig gsal byed nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni dpal sa skya nas shar phyogs su dpag tshad gcig tsam bgrod pa'i gnas/ chos 'jig rten gyi khrims gnyis/ sngon rabs 'dzangs pa'i lugs bzhin legs par skyong ba'i chos kyi rgyal po rim par byon pa'i gnas shrī singha gra ma hā se na'i rtse mo dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod gsal ba'i bshes gnyen zla ba grags pa zhes bya bas bris pa'o// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gshed dmar gyi khrid yig gsal byed nges don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi them skas/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
